extracted.intended_audience: credentialed sports journalists, broadcasters, and team media/communications staff covering NBA teams
extracted.subtask_description: Operational instructions and contact/reference information for media covering NBA teams, including media entrance/parking, will-call/credential procedures, venue directions, and lists of team and outlet contacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media check-in / Media will call location
rubrics_metrics.description: Location and contact point where credentialed media pick up credentials or check in for games (e.g., 'Media will enter across the pedestrian bridge located on the second floor of West Garage. Media will call will be located at the Media Check-In counter in the west quarter of the Main Entrance.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each venue specifies a Media Check‑In or Will Call counter (example: Gainbridge Fieldhouse Entry Pavilion; Intuit Dome Media Check‑In counter). The guide lists exact entrance points and floor/garage references; follow signage (e.g., 'look for sign that says Media Entrance').

rubrics_metrics.name: Media entrance location
rubrics_metrics.description: Designated physical entrance(s) for media to access the venue (e.g., 'MEDIA ENTRANCE: Located at the Practice Court Hallway Entrance on Level P1 of the parking garage, near the P1 elevators.' / 'MEDIA ENTRANCE: Private entrance adjacent to Chick Hearn Court Entry').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specified media entrance rather than public doors; entrances may be in garages, practice-court hallways, or private entrances adjacent to courts. Entrances often include directional notes (which side/corner of facility).

rubrics_metrics.name: Media parking (including visiting media parking)
rubrics_metrics.description: Where credentialed media should park and parking-lot locations (examples: 'Media will park in the Intuit Dome West Garage located at 10117 S Prairie Ave' and 'Parking is available for visiting team media members on the visitor’s traveling media list. The parking lot, located on Virginia Ave., is the ground floor of the parking garage directly east of Gainbridge Fieldhouse.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some venues provide dedicated media lots/garages and give driving directions to the lot; visiting media parking may be restricted to those on the traveling media list. Contact the team's communications department for parking arrangements where noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credentials / Will Call / Answers Portal procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and locations for ticket/credential pickup (e.g., 'BOX OFFICE WILL CALL: Entry Pavilion of Gainbridge Fieldhouse', 'MEDIA ENTRANCE AND CREDENTIAL WILL CALL: Southeast corner of Gainbridge Fieldhouse, on Delaware St., look for sign that says Media Entrance', 'ANSWERS PORTAL (Ticket Will Call): The Answers portal is located East of the doors in the Main Entrance. Can also be contacted at 888-311-0231.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow venue-specific will-call instructions and portals; phone numbers and web links may be provided for the ticket/credential portal. Bring ID and instructions as required by venue policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue directions / driving directions
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed driving directions to the venue from common routes and highways (examples: multi-step directions to Gainbridge Fieldhouse, Intuit Dome from LAX, Crypto.com Arena from LAX, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Venues provide turn-by-turn directions from major interstates/freeways and airports; use these to plan arrival routes and estimate travel time. Some venues also reference external parking/directions pages (e.g., Intuit Dome parking link).

rubrics_metrics.name: Press room contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Phone/fax numbers and other contact details for the press room (e.g., 'Courtside: (317) 917-2954 / Press Room: (317) 917-2955 / Press Room Fax: (317) 917-2969/2970').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press room phone/fax numbers are provided for credentialed media to use on game day; use these contacts for media logistics, faxing credentials, and last‑minute coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team communications / PR contact list
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive list of team communications and PR staff with names, titles, office/mobile numbers, emails, and social handles (examples across teams: Vice President of Communications, Senior Director of Basketball Communications, Director of Communications, Managers and Coordinators with direct contact info).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed team PR contacts for credential requests, interview scheduling, media questions, game-day logistics, and emergency communications. Multiple staff often cover different areas (player comms, corporate comms, digital).

rubrics_metrics.name: Approved broadcasters, radio & television contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists of team broadcasters and broadcast partner contacts for radio and TV, including flagship stations, program directors, producers, play-by-play and analyst talent (e.g., station addresses, studio/producer phone numbers, program directors, hosts, and X handles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These entries identify broadcast partners and production contacts for coordinating interviews, timing, and broadcast credentials; include station studio hotlines and producer contacts for on-air coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wire services and internet media contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact details for national/regional wire services and internet outlets covering the team (Associated Press, ESPN.com, The Athletic, local sports sites), including reporter names, phone numbers, and emails.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wire and internet media contacts are listed for press relations and distribution; use these for broader media outreach, story placement, or to confirm existing coverage/assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writers and beat reporters regularly assigned to club
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists of writers, beat reporters, and columnists who are regularly assigned to the team with their outlets and contact information (examples: 'Writers Regularly Assigned to Club' sections naming AP, local newspapers, The Athletic reporters, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These names indicate usual beat coverage and are useful for coordinating access, understanding coverage landscape, and identifying reporters to contact for story background or collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Producer and media-production contacts (team and traveling producers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Contacts for producers who travel with the club or work team-side production (e.g., 'PRODUCER WHO REGULARLY TRAVELS WITH CLUB: STEVEN ROSE, PRODUCER, SOCAL, ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Producer contacts are provided for coordinating live event production, camera/technical needs, and credentialing for media production crews; they can also assist with technical questions and pre/post-game production plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital/team website producers & social media contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Contacts for digital media, website production, and social media staff (e.g., 'Vice President of Digital Marketing', 'Digital Marketing Coordinator', team PR social handles like 'PR X: @pacers_PR').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use digital contacts for requests related to game content, multimedia assets, credentials for digital reporters, and to coordinate social or web-based coverage; social handles are provided for immediate outreach or verification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media parking access by credentialing / departmental contact for parking
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural note that media parking is provided to credentialed media by contacting the team's communications department (example from Memphis: 'Media parking is provided to credentialed media by contacting the Memphis Grizzlies Communications Department.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Credentialing may be required to obtain parking permission; contact the listed communications department well in advance to arrange parking for media vehicles.
